`Section 01 · The annexes and their approved decoration`

## A deliberately long section label.

---

<!-- _class: content -->

## The footer band has four marks and not enough room.

The running footer text and the section rail are both long on purpose: this is the
contended band, where an absolute footer with a fixed budget and an in-flow nowrap
rail used to overprint each other because neither could yield.

---

<!-- _class: list -->

## A second slide in the same section.

- The band's geometry is a property of the section, not the slide
- So every slide inside the section carries the same contended footer
- Both marks must stay legible, on one line, without overlapping
